title: Messy CSV & JSON Data Cleaner, Deduplicator & Transformer
target_pain: Founders, marketers, and developers waste hours cleaning messy CSVs, stripping duplicates, fixing broken format encodings, and prepping dirty data exports before importing into CRMs, databases, or AI tools.
key_features: Auto-detects CSV, TSV, Pipe-delimited, and JSON format inputs
Instant Deduplication by primary keys or full record comparison
Regex Find & Replace engine with live batch preview
HTML Tag Stripping, Whitespace Trimming & Smart Email/Phone sanitization
1-Click Export to Clean CSV, Formatted JSON, or Clipboard
Real-time processing stats (Rows cleaned, Duplicates purged, Bytes saved)
